study: Three-minute re-read: does any entry rule or filter already built here pick entries whose next 3 minutes beat the same name's later 3 minutes and a random other name's same 3 minutes, by enough to clear the measured spread?
registered_at: 2026-10-21, before any 3-minute outcome is computed on any of these rules
origin: Operator 10/21: 'what gives us a profit run for three minutes, in order for us to capture that with our exit'. The desk holds 3-8 minutes (book-open standard), but the entry studies mostly measured 10-minute markouts (early_entry_honest family, indicator_confirm, indicator_confirm_hist, prescreen_turn). A 10-minute null can hide a 3-minute effect that reverses by minute 10.
prior: LOW, and the 5-minute numbers are already printed: H1-H5 net5 DiD within -2.1..+1.2 bp, |t| <= 1.52 (INDICATOR_CONFIRM_HIST_2026-10-21_raw.md); prescreen_turn's %R rules about -0.1 / -0.2 bp at 5 minutes on n ~214-266k (PRESCREEN_TURN_2026-10-17.md). net3 is the first 3 minutes of net5, so a +5 bp lift at 3 minutes needs a ~-5 bp reversal in minutes 4-5. Expect most of the 18 cells to be near-vacuous. This is a DISCOVERY pass on data already mined at other horizons; only the confirmation sample can make a claim. Desk fills drift -9 bp at 5 minutes (holding-longer-loses-more).

data.discovery: the warehouse 2026-05-11 .. 2026-10-15 (110 scored sessions, 10 look-back), exactly as indicator_confirm_hist_prereg.json: 400-name seeded sample ('indicator-hist-sample') for %R rules and H filters, every name with 10 prior SIP sessions for S3-S7; IEX features, SIP outcomes; halves A <= 2026-07-29 < B.

entries.rules: Population: the 400-name 'indicator-hist-sample' (indicator_confirm_hist), every RTH minute counted as on the board (the honest rules' board-minute requirement does not apply to an unscreened sample). Onsets with a 15-minute refractory, decision minute m = onset + 1 in 10:00-15:30 (15:27 latest so the exit is inside RTH). %R lines AND RSI-2 warmed on the previous session's last 220 RTH IEX bars (early_entry_honest.name_day_series with WARM_LINES on). Rules (early_entry_honest definitions, unchanged): PRE, SQ, MID, BOTHUP, OSL, IGN, RSI2T, and CON = the live-shape con_live_series (connors_green_prereg: raw IEX bars, close > SMA200, close < SMA5, RSI-2 < 10 over the joined prior + today series; False when any close in the 200-bar window is missing), not the gridded con_flags. S3-S7: structure_pullback definitions with the indicator_confirm_hist adaptation on every name with 10 prior SIP sessions; decision minute = setup bar end; entry at the open of that minute (the bar after the setup bar).
entries.filters: H1-H5 of indicator_confirm_hist on PRE entries, unchanged.

outcome: PRIMARY timing (shared with order_flow_pilot): the onset bar closes at the start of minute m = onset + 1, and the entry is the SIP OPEN of minute m (no dead minute). net3 = SIP close of minute m+2 / SIP open of minute m - 1 (3 one-minute bars). Information: the earlier convention, entry at the open of m+1 (lag 1). Required cost: net3 > 0 at 5 bp (the live 0.05% spread cap as a round trip; this unscreened sample has no spread screen, and the desk's measured ~3 bp applies only to capped names). 3 and 10 bp are printed. net1, net2, net5 and the max favourable / adverse excursion inside the 3 minutes are information.
control: as indicator_confirm_hist amended: d = vs the same name's later decision minute c in m+1 .. m+60 (entry at the open of c, same 3-bar hold, seed tag 'three-min-v1'); x = vs a random other name of the same pool at the same minute (seed tag 'three-min-cross'). Both required.
statistic: Rules: lift_d and lift_x per day, day-equal, day-clustered t (df = days - 1). Filters: DiD_d and DiD_x as indicator_confirm_hist.
multiplicity: One family of 18 (13 rules + 5 filters): one-sided p 0.025 / 18 at df = days - 1 (~3.1 at df 54).
discovery_pass: a cell PASSES discovery if, in BOTH halves: lift (or DiD) >= +5 bp at t >= t_crit on d AND on x; mean net3 > 0 at 5 bp; name-day-equal lift > 0; drop-3-names and drop-3-days >= 0. FAIL: a half with t <= -2 on d or x, or the 97.5% upper bound below +5 bp on d and x in both halves (t <= -2 wins over d / x disagreement). Floors: 300 entries and 20 days per half, else UNDERPOWERED.
confirmation_pass: only discovery PASS cells (k of them) run on the confirmation sessions, unchanged, with halves at its median session: floors 300 entries and 20 days (else UNDERPOWERED, not a lead); lift (or DiD) > 0 on d AND x with one-sided p 0.025 / k at df = days - 1; mean net3 > 0 at 5 bp; name-day-equal lift > 0; drop-3-names and drop-3-days >= 0. A cell is a LEAD only if it passes both; a LEAD earns a forward paper test, never a config change by itself.
fail_rule: a cell is closed at 3 minutes for effects >= 5 bp if the 97.5% upper bound is below +5 bp on d and x in both discovery halves (as indicator_confirm_hist).
calibration: the indicator_confirm_hist null machinery extended to ALL 13 rules and 5 filters, with the 3-bar hold and the lag-0 entry, seed tag 'three-min-null', 120 sessions x 2,500 names; every rule and filter must reach >= 300 entries per half on the null or the study is BLOCKED; the per-df Bonferroni bound and the H2 / H3 investigate rule of indicator_confirm_hist amended_3 apply. Plus the coin-flip placebo for the filters. Binding; run before any discovery outcome is read.
information_only: the desk's own paper fills at 1/2/3/5 minutes (positions-state fills, not the trade log)
max favourable / adverse excursion inside the 3 minutes (what an exit could have captured)
no_retuning: rules, filters, the 3-bar hold, 3 bp, the 5 bp bar, the floors, the two samples and the seeds are fixed. A 2- or 4-minute version is a new prereg.
declared_deviations: unscreened liquid names, not the movers board
bar-open entry has no spread inside; the 3 bp cost is the measured average, not this name-minute's spread
